import jax.numpy as jnp


def horseshoe_prior_cn(N, name_prefix=""):
    """Standard Horseshoe prior (Carvalho et al., 2010) for c_n.

    Adaptive shrinkage: models with no contamination get shrunk toward 0,
    models with real contamination are estimated with minimal shrinkage.
    Replaces HalfNormal(sigma_c) which applies uniform shrinkage.
